SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dmht_ckd_egfr (
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  splevel varchar(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DELETE FROM s_dmht_ckd_egfr  WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF  EXISTS  ckd_egfr;
CREATE TEMPORARY  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS   ckd_egfr(
HOSPCODE VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
PID VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL,
cid VARCHAR(13) DEFAULT NULL,
sex VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL,
nation VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT NULL,
g_egfr text,
g_n17 text,
egfr_r1 varchar(20) default '0',
egfr_d1 date default null,
egfr_r2 varchar(20) default '0',
egfr_d2 date default null,
egfr_r3 varchar(20) default '0',
egfr_d3 date default null,
egfr_r4 varchar(20) default '0',
egfr_d4 date default null,

day1 int(2) default 0,
day2 int(2) default 0,
day3 int(2) default 0,

xy1 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
xy2 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
xy3 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
x21 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
x22 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
x23 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,

s_x int(9) default 0,
s_y DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
s_xy DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0,
s_x2 int(9) default 0,
sumseq int(2) default 0,
egfr_b365 VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT null,
diagccode VARCHAR(7) DEFAULT null,
egfr  VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT null,
date_serv date,
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid),
KEY (hospcode,pid),
KEY(hospcode),
KEY(cid)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARACTER SET=utf8 IGNORE AS

(SELECT e.*,i.DIAGCODE,i.egfr_ok,i.date_serv
FROM  t_ckd_service i INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr2y e ON i.HOSPCODE=e.HOSPCODE AND i.PID=e.PID
WHERE  /*Stage3-4*/		
				(
						LEFT( i.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N183','N184')		 OR  
						(LEFT( i.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N189') AND ( i.egfr_ok<60 AND i.egfr_ok>=15))
			OR (
								(LEFT( DIAGCODE,4)  IN ('E102','E112','E122','E132','E142','I151','N083') 
									OR LEFT(diagcode,3) IN('I12','I13','N02','N03','N04','N05','N06','N07','N08','N11','N13','N14','N20','N21','N22','N23') 
								) AND  ( i.egfr_ok<60 AND  i.egfr_ok>=15)
					)
			) 
	AND i.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
	);


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dmht_ckd_egfr  
(
SELECT
@id,s.HOSPCODE,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode,NULL as splevel
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT s.hospcode,s.pid) t
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(s.egfr_b365 > -5 ,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),null)) r
FROM
ckd_egfr  s INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON s.cid=d.cid
INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode=s.HOSPCODE 
		AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hostype  IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND  h.hdc_regist=1 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON s.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND s.PID=p.PID 
WHERE  s.sumseq>1 AND p.NATION in(99) 
GROUP BY s.HOSPCODE
);
rows.aname: จำนวนผู้ป่วยเบาหวาน และ/หรือ ความดันโลหิตสูง สัญชาติไทย CKD 3-4  ที่มารับบริการที่โรงพยาบาลได้รับการตรวจ creatinine/มีผล eGFR ≥ 2 ค่า และมีค่าเฉลี่ยการเปลี่ยนแปลง < 5

rows.notice:
จำนวนผู้ป่วยโรคไตเรื้อรัง Stage 3-4 หมายถึง ผู้ป่วยจากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD ที่มีรหัสโรคเป็น
1. N183-184 หรือ
2. N189,E102, E112, E122, E132, E142 ,I12*, I13*, I151, N083, N02*, N03*, N04*, N05*, N06*, N07*, N08*, N11*, N13*, N14*, N20*, N21*, N22*, N23* ที่มี 60 > eGFR>= 15
คำนวน Stage เมื่อสิ้นสุดไตรมาส
ผู้ป่วยจะต้องได้รับการตรวจ creatinine/มีผล eGFR ≥ 2 ค่า จึงจะถูกนำมาประเมินอัตราการลดลงของ eGFR ได้

SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 ); SET @b_year := ( SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1 ); SET @start_d := concat( @b_year - 1, '1001' ); SET @end_d := concat( @b_year, '0930' ); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS ckd_egfr; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ckd_egfr( HOSPCODE VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, PID VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, cid VARCHAR(13) DEFAULT NULL, sex VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL, nation VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT NULL, g_egfr text, g_n17 text, egfr_r1 varchar(20) default '0', egfr_d1 date default null, egfr_r2 varchar(20) default '0', egfr_d2 date default null, egfr_r3 varchar(20) default '0', egfr_d3 date default null, egfr_r4 varchar(20) default '0', egfr_d4 date default null, day1 int(2) default 0, day2 int(2) default 0, day3 int(2) default 0, xy1 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, xy2 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, xy3 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, x21 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, x22 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, x23 DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, s_x int(9) default 0, s_y DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, s_xy DECIMAL(12,2) default 0.0, s_x2 int(9) default 0, sumseq int(2) default 0, egfr_b365 VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT null, PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid), KEY (hospcode,pid), KEY(hospcode), KEY(cid) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARACTER SET=utf8 IGNORE AS (SELECT e.*,i.DIAGCODE,i.egfr_ok as egfr,i.date_serv FROM t_ckd_service i INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr2y e ON i.HOSPCODE=e.HOSPCODE AND i.PID=e.PID WHERE /*Stage3-4*/ ( LEFT( i.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N183','N184') OR (LEFT( i.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N189') AND ( i.egfr_ok<60 AND i.egfr_ok>=15)) OR ( (LEFT( DIAGCODE,4) IN ('E102','E112','E122','E132','E142','I151','N083') OR LEFT(diagcode,3) IN('I12','I13','N02','N03','N04','N05','N06','N07','N08','N11','N13','N14','N20','N21','N22','N23') ) AND ( i.egfr_ok<60 AND i.egfr_ok>=15) ) ) AND i.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx ( SELECT h.hoscode hospcode,p.PID,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME ,p.SEX,p.BIRTH,p.HID,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.NATION,p.TYPEAREA ,s.date_serv,s.diagcode,s.egfr ,REPLACE(s.g_egfr,'},{','}
{') g_egfr ,REPLACE(s.g_n17,'},{','}
{') g_n17 ,s.egfr_d1,s.egfr_d2,s.egfr_d3,s.egfr_d4 ,s.egfr_r1,s.egfr_r2,s.egfr_r3,s.egfr_r4 ,s.s_x,s.s_y,s.s_xy,s.s_x2,round(s.egfr_b365,4) egfr_b365 ,IF(s.egfr_b365 > -5 ,'ผ่านตัวชี้วัด','ไม่ผ่าน') result FROM ckd_egfr s INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON s.cid=d.cid INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode=s.HOSPCODE AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON s.hospcode=p.hospcode AND s.pid=p.pid GROUP BY s.HOSPCODE,s.PID ); SELECT h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.PID,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME ,d.SEX,d.BIRTH,d.HID,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.NATION,d.TYPEAREA ,d.date_serv,d.diagcode,d.egfr ,d.g_egfr,d.g_n17 ,d.egfr_d1,d.egfr_d2,d.egfr_d3,d.egfr_d4 ,d.egfr_r1,d.egfr_r2,d.egfr_r3,d.egfr_r4 ,d.s_x,d.s_y,d.s_xy,d.s_x2,d.egfr_b365 ,d.result FROM tx d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode WHERE 1 = 1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
